CDK4/6-cyclin D1 complex in tumourigenesis

The CDK4/6-cyclin D1 complex in tumourigenesis. A schematic overview of the mechanisms leading to CDK4/6-cyclin D1 hyperactivation in cancer cells and the role of this complex during tumourigenesis. Both genetic alterations and mitogenic signalling pathways contribute to the increased reliance of cancer cells on the CDK4/6-cyclin D1 axis. Upon activation, this complex regulates key oncogenic processes, including cell proliferation, metastasis, and angiogenesis
